params.val: blocks the incoming move's secondary/additional effect that targets the HOLDER (status chance, stat-drop chance, flinch chance, etc.) -- the move's direct damage, primary effect, and any secondary effect that targets the ATTACKER ITSELF still apply normally

CORRECTED a real gap -- verified against Showdown data/abilities.ts (shielddust): onModifySecondaries filters out all secondaries EXCEPT ones with effect.self set (secondaries that hit the move's own user) -- those still go through untouched. This entry previously implied ALL secondaries are blocked.
